content.value_statement: Referral programs fail when incentives, timing, and tracking are unclear. This skill helps design, launch, and optimize referral and affiliate programs.
actual_capabilities: Compare referral, affiliate, and hybrid program models.
Design single-sided, double-sided, and tiered incentive structures.
Estimate reward ceilings using LTV, gross margin, and CAC.
Draft affiliate outreach and referral launch email sequences.
Plan fraud prevention, dashboard metrics, and launch checklists.
limitations: Does not connect to live referral platforms or analytics tools.
Requires user-provided LTV, CAC, margin, and conversion data for accurate modeling.
Benchmarks are general and should be validated against your market.
Does not provide legal review of affiliate terms or tax rules.

use_cases.title: Launch a Customer Referral Program
use_cases.description: Design rewards, referral prompts, launch emails, and tracking metrics for an existing customer base.

use_cases.title: Structure an Affiliate Program
use_cases.description: Choose commission rules, cookie duration, partner enablement materials, and recruitment channels.

use_cases.title: Improve Referral Economics
use_cases.description: Model incentive limits, referral ROI, payback period, and fraud controls before scaling the program.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Program Type
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose between a referral program, an affiliate program, or a hybrid model. My product is [product], my audience is [audience], and my average customer value is [LTV].

prompt_templates.title: Design Incentives
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three incentive options for my referral program. Use my LTV of [amount], gross margin of [percent], current CAC of [amount], and target customer behavior of [behavior].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Affiliate Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an affiliate program launch plan for [company]. Include commission structure, ideal affiliates, enablement assets, outreach sequence, and performance metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Program Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this referral program using the data below. Identify bottlenecks, incentive risks, fraud signals, cohort insights, and prioritized experiments. Data: [metrics and notes].

output_examples.input: A B2B SaaS company wants to reward customers for qualified demo referrals.
output_examples.output: The skill may recommend a flat reward after a qualified demo, delayed payout after activation, partner-facing copy, and dashboard metrics for referral rate, conversion, CAC, and payback.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce brand wants creators to promote a subscription product.
output_examples.output: The skill may propose an affiliate program with percentage commissions, a clear cookie window, creator enablement assets, fraud safeguards, and a recruitment email.

output_examples.input: A mature referral program has low share rates and poor conversion.
output_examples.output: The skill may separate sharing problems from conversion problems, then suggest trigger timing tests, landing page improvements, and incentive experiments.

best_practices: Provide LTV, CAC, margin, and current referral metrics when asking for incentive recommendations.
Ask for separate plans for customer referrals, affiliates, and hybrid programs when audiences differ.
Review fraud controls, payout timing, and terms before launching public rewards.
anti_patterns: Do not set rewards before checking unit economics and payback period.
Do not rely on one generic referral message for every customer segment.
Do not pay rewards before verifying meaningful activation or purchase quality.

faq.question: Can this skill design both referral and affiliate programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares customer referral, affiliate, and hybrid models, then recommends structures for each use case.

faq.question: What business data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide customer LTV, gross margin, current CAC, conversion rates, reward budget, target audience, and available tools.

faq.question: Can it help with fraud prevention?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common abuse patterns, verification rules, delayed payouts, referral caps, and manual review triggers.

faq.question: Does it integrate with referral platforms?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend tool selection criteria, but it does not connect to or configure external platforms.

faq.question: Can it write launch emails?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes referral launch, nurture, re-engagement, and affiliate outreach templates that can be adapted.

faq.question: Is this legal or tax advice?
faq.answer: No. Ask a qualified professional to review affiliate terms, disclosures, taxes, and payout rules.
